notice: Rules for sorting recurring charges. Keep-for-now and decide-later keywords are checked before anything can be sorted as stoppable, so a charge that must continue is never counted in the daily headline. Keywords match whole words, case-insensitively, against the charge label, provider aliases and provider id.

keep_for_now.note: Home insurance usually needs to stay active while the estate is settled, even if the house is empty.
Car insurance usually needs to stay active until the vehicle is sold or transferred.
Utilities usually need to stay on while the home is occupied or being looked after.
Association fees usually continue while the estate still owns the property.
Alarm monitoring helps protect the home while it is being settled.

decide_later.note: A mortgage needs a decision with whoever is handling the estate. Stopping payments can put the home at risk.
A car loan or lease is tied to the vehicle. Stopping payments can lead to repossession.
A timeshare can carry obligations for the estate. It needs a decision, not a cancellation.
Ask about any benefit before changing a life insurance, annuity or pension account.
Debts and leases are usually settled by the estate, with notice terms. Ask before stopping or paying.
Insurance can protect property or carry a benefit. Check what it covers before stopping it.

stoppable.note: There may be belongings inside. Plan a visit before closing it.
You can stop this whenever you’re ready.
